gmcm.language.name: Language
gmcm.language.tooltip: Choose the mod's display language. If the current game fonts cannot display Chinese (such as when the game is set to English), English is used automatically.
gmcm.controls.refresh: After changing controller layout or style, save and reopen this menu to see updated controls.
gmcm.button-remapping.name: Button Remapping
gmcm.button-remapping.tooltip:
Remap A/B and X/Y based on your controller layout and control style.
Turn off to use the default Android mapping.
gmcm.controller-layout.name: Controller Layout
gmcm.controller-layout.tooltip:
Choose the physical layout of your controller. Requires Button Remapping.
Switch/Odin: A right, B bottom, X top, Y left.
Xbox: A bottom, B right, X left, Y top.
PlayStation: Cross = A, Circle = B, Square = X, Triangle = Y.
gmcm.control-style.name: Control Style
gmcm.control-style.tooltip:
Choose a console control scheme. Requires Button Remapping.
Switch: right button confirms, bottom button cancels.
Xbox/PS: bottom button confirms, right button cancels.
gmcm.console-chests.name: Console Chests
gmcm.console-chests.tooltip: In chests, transfer full stacks with A, one item with Y (hold to repeat), sort with X, snap to Fill Stacks with RB, and navigate sidebar buttons and the color picker.
gmcm.console-shops.name: Console Shops
gmcm.console-shops.tooltip: Buy with A, adjust purchase quantity with LB/RB, jump through items with the right stick, and sell full stacks with A or single items with Y on the sell tab.
gmcm.console-animal-menu.name: Console Animal Menu
gmcm.console-animal-menu.tooltip: Highlights a button when Marnie's animal sell/move dialog opens and lets you confirm the sale with A.
gmcm.console-toolbar.name: Console Toolbar
gmcm.console-toolbar.tooltip: Use a fixed 12-slot toolbar. Switch rows with LB/RB and move within the row with LT/RT.
gmcm.pickup-to-active-row.name: Pickup to Active Row
gmcm.pickup-to-active-row.tooltip: New items go to the active toolbar row if there's space. Picking up forage, drops, gifts, or purchases keeps your tool selected. Furniture is selected automatically so you can place it again.
gmcm.console-inventory.name: Console Inventory
gmcm.console-inventory.tooltip: Use A to pick up or place items, Y to pick up one from a stack, and Y on a fishing rod or slingshot to attach or remove bait, tackle, or ammo.
gmcm.console-shipping.name: Console Shipping
gmcm.console-shipping.tooltip: In the shipping bin, use A to ship the entire stack or Y to ship one item.
gmcm.right-stick-cursor.name: Right-Stick Cursor
gmcm.right-stick-cursor.tooltip: Use the right stick to move the cursor and aim tools, as on Switch. The cursor hides after a few seconds of inactivity and tools target the tile you're facing again. Turn off to stop the right stick from moving the cursor.
gmcm.journal-button.name: Hold Start to Open Journal
gmcm.journal-button.tooltip: Tap Start to open the game menu. Hold it for about half a second to open the Quest Log. Turn off to use the default Start behavior.
gmcm.cutscene-skip.name: Start Skips Cutscenes
gmcm.cutscene-skip.tooltip: Press Start twice during a skippable cutscene to skip it.
gmcm.carpenter-menu-fix.name: Carpenter Menu Fix
gmcm.carpenter-menu-fix.tooltip: Prevents Robin's building menu from immediately closing when you open it with A.
gmcm.furniture-debounce.name: Furniture Debounce
gmcm.furniture-debounce.tooltip: Adds a roughly 0.5-second cooldown between Y interactions so furniture isn't immediately picked up or placed again.
gmcm.console-geode-menu.name: Console Geode Menu
gmcm.console-geode-menu.tooltip: At Clint's, press A once to place and crack the selected geode, with its tooltip shown automatically. Turn off to restore Android controls (X cracks and A toggles the tooltip).
gmcm.furniture-placement.name: Console Furniture Placement
gmcm.furniture-placement.tooltip: Shows a single outline where the furniture will be placed, replacing the green grid of possible placements.
gmcm.craftable-placement.name: Console Craftable Placement
gmcm.craftable-placement.tooltip: Shows a single outline where a placeable craftable such as a machine, keg, or sprinkler will be placed.
gmcm.hold-to-craft.name: Hold A to Craft
gmcm.hold-to-craft.tooltip: Hold A in the crafting or cooking menu to craft continuously. Stops when you run out of ingredients or inventory space.
gmcm.museum-donation.name: Museum Donation (Controller)
gmcm.museum-donation.tooltip: Use a controller to select a donation, move across the museum grid with the D-pad, and place it with A. Turn off to restore touch-only donation.
gmcm.game-menu-navigation.name: Console Menus
gmcm.game-menu-navigation.tooltip: Adds controller navigation to the Social, Animals, Crafting, Collections, Options, and Mod Config pages.
gmcm.move-while-charging.name: Charge Tools While Moving
gmcm.move-while-charging.tooltip: Hold the tool button while walking to charge a Copper or better Hoe or Watering Can. Release to use the charged area, or tap for a single use. Basic tools, Pickaxes, and Axes are unaffected.
gmcm.slingshot-aim.name: Console Slingshot Aim
gmcm.slingshot-aim.tooltip: Hold the physical tool button to draw the slingshot, aim with the left stick, and release to fire once. You can move normally when you're not aiming.
gmcm.drop-blocker.name: Console Drop Blocker
gmcm.drop-blocker.tooltip: Applies the game's roughly 1.2-second pickup delay to deliberately dropped items. Monster loot, harvests, and other drops are unaffected.
gmcm.dialogue-cursor.name: Console Dialogue Cursor
gmcm.dialogue-cursor.tooltip: With a controller, highlights the selected dialogue response with a red outline and a finger cursor. Touch keeps the default yellow highlight.
gmcm.free-cursor.name: Free Cursor on Settings
gmcm.free-cursor.tooltip: Use the original free cursor instead of snapping on the Options and Mod Config pages. Requires Console Menus.
gmcm.hide-touch-options.name: Hide Touch Options (Controller)
gmcm.hide-touch-options.tooltip: While using a controller, hide virtual joystick settings, the on-screen controls toggle, invisible button width, pinch zoom, and the adjust-joypad button from the Options page.
gmcm.bumpers-instead-of-triggers.name: Use Bumpers Instead of Triggers
gmcm.bumpers-instead-of-triggers.tooltip:
For controllers whose triggers aren't detected, such as some Xbox Bluetooth controllers.
Toolbar: D-pad up/down switches rows, and LB/RB moves within a row.
Shops: LB/RB adjusts purchase quantity.
gmcm.item-stowing.name: Item Stowing
gmcm.item-stowing.tooltip:
Adds the game's Item Stowing setting, normally hidden on Android.
Press the tool button while holding an item that cannot be placed there to put it away. Press again to take it out.
Gamepad only applies while using a controller.
gmcm.verbose-logging.name: Verbose Logging
gmcm.verbose-logging.tooltip: Write detailed information to the log for debugging.
controls.remapping-disabled:
Button remapping is off.
The controller uses Android's default mapping.
Enable Button Remapping to customize it.

controls.toolbar.dpad:

LB/RB/D-Pad Left/Right - Move Left/Right
ui.options.hide-hit-while-moving: Hide tool hit location while moving
ui.mod-description: Console-style controller support for Stardew Valley on Android, with English and Simplified Chinese options.
